question: Find the value of {[ {{{( {(5)/(8)} )} ⁻ ⁷} times {{( {(8)/(5)} )} ⁻ ⁴} times {{( {(1)/(4)} )} ⁻ ³}} ] ⁻ ³}
solution:
**Given:**

{[ {{{( {(5)/(8)} )} ⁻ ⁷} times {{( {(8)/(5)} )} ⁻ ⁴} times {{( {(1)/(4)} )} ⁻ ³}} ] ⁻ ³}

**Formula used:**

We use the property of exponents: ( a^m times b^n )^p = am · p times bⁿ · p

Also, ( dfrac{a}{b} )⁻ⁿ = ( dfrac{b}{a} )^n

**Calculation:**

Step 1: Simplify each term:

( dfrac{5}{8} )⁻⁷ = ( dfrac{8}{5} )⁷

( dfrac{8}{5} )⁻⁴ = ( dfrac{5}{8} )⁴

( dfrac{1}{4} )⁻³ = 4³ = 64

Step 2: Combine the terms:

( dfrac{8}{5} )⁷ times ( dfrac{5}{8} )⁴ times 64

Step 3: Group the powers of 8 and 5:

dfrac{8⁷}{5⁷} times dfrac{5⁴}{8⁴} times 64

Step 4: Simplify powers:

dfrac{8⁷⁻⁴}{5⁷⁻⁴} times 64 = dfrac{8³}{5³} times 64

 dfrac{8³}{5³} times 4³ = (32³)/(5³) 

{[ {{{( {(5)/(8)} )} ⁻ ⁷} times {{( {(8)/(5)} )} ⁻ ⁴} times {{( {(1)/(4)} )} ⁻ ³}} ] ⁻ ³} = [(32³)/(5³)]⁻³

⇒ [(32³)/(5³)]⁻³ = [(5³)/(32³)]³ = [(5)/(32)]⁹

**∴ The value of the expression is {( {(5)/(32)} )}⁹.**
